'''Ulek Talstin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] brigand who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by [[D'Mayna Stallaphalat]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Every possible depictions of Ulek Talstin]]
Ulek Talstin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Ulek Talstin changed each time a player performed this quest. Species that Talstin could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Talstin. However, the quest dialogue given by Stella indicated that Ulek Talstin was a [[Gender/Legends|male]].
